A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GROVE and contain the complete 22-page paper, including appendices A–E. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendix material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original physical-simulation experiments, human evaluations, and ablations in Tables 1–4, plus supplementary SAC and Pose2CLIP evaluations in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the humanoid skill experiments, standard RL benchmarks, human ratings, and appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: The combined LLM/VLM reward, Pose2CLIP architecture and training objective, hierarchical controller, and reward-regeneration procedure remain unchanged, including Algorithm 1 and appendix implementations.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same AMASS/Motion-X training sources, humanoid instruction sets, and Cartpole, Ant, ANYmal, and Humanoid tasks. Appendix task coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains AvatarCLIP, TMR, MoMask, MotionGPT, and AnySkill. Tables 2–3 retain direct reward optimization and VLM-RM comparisons; Appendix B.2 and Table A2 also preserve their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Training configurations, metrics, preprocessing, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both versions retain the 30-participant motion study, 25-participant Pose2CLIP evaluation, and supplementary SAC settings.

E4.justification: The seven-configuration ablation, Figure 7 convergence analysis, Appendix C.1 RDP comparison, and supplementary SAC and Pose2CLIP analyses are retained without changes.

E5.justification: The same statistical reporting is retained throughout the tables, plots, and appendices. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains GROVE's completion score of 7.924 and naturalness score of 6.793; Table A2 retains Pose2CLIP's matrix score of 0.48. Plotted curves and motion illustrations also match.

T1.justification: The RDP formalization, reward equations (1)–(3), and similarity-matrix formulation in Appendix D.2 are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning complementary rewards, Pose2CLIP, generalization, motion quality, task completion, and training efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of complementary reward guidance, rendering quality, RDP effectiveness, and the ANYmal jumping exception remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Prompts, generated reward code, data-processing details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, and project/model-access disclosures remain unchanged, including Appendices B, D, and E.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 52 reference entries retain the same cited works and research positioning. No substantive novelty comparison or relationship to prior work changes.

P1.justification: Section 4.2 changes 'Appendix C.2' to 'Sec. C.2'; the acknowledgment changes grant number 62376031 to 62376009, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The narrative and section structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Minor text reflow on pages 7–8 changes where the ablation discussion crosses page and column boundaries. Figures, plotted curves, table structures, and appendix displays retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 updates an acknowledgment identifier and cross-reference wording, with minor text reflow. The method, empirical evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, so these editorial adjustments do not materially change overall paper quality.
